title: Infection Prevention — Interim Water Use Guidance

fields.organization: Ottawa River Regional Medical Center — Infection Prevention
fields.location: HCC (Room A-114), Central Plant Water Storage Area, Outpatient Dialysis Center
fields.summary: Interim infection control guidance issued in response to the City of Toledo Do Not Drink advisory and confirmed water loop failure in dialysis. All non-sterile water uses are restricted pending health department coordination. The proposed controls are consistent with CDC guidance for waterborne pathogen mitigation during public health advisories.

findings.notes: All public and clinical taps marked with 'Do Not Drink' signage
All ice machines disabled; no ice to be served
Unfiltered taps shut off; coffee brewed only with bottled water

findings.item: Hand hygiene in patient care areas
findings.notes: Alcohol-based rub to be used for routine hand hygiene; soap and water to be reserved for visible soil using bottled water in immunocompromised zones
No tap water for oral hygiene; use of bottled water or pre-moistened wipes only
Food Services to begin using disposable ware in all patient areas
All fountains capped and posted with 'Do Not Drink' signs
RO loop offline; portable units in use but not on city main
Signs posted on all taps and fountains; awaiting final approval from HCC
To be confirmed in next shift briefing

actionsTaken: Issued interim guidance to HCC via secure messaging
Posted 'Do Not Drink' signs on all taps and fountains
Notified Food Services to switch to disposable ware
Directed sterile processing to suspend non-urgent reprocessing until water status confirmed
Informed CNO and DFEM of policy rollout
recommendations: Confirm protocol alignment with Toledo-Lucas County Health Department within 1 hour
Formalize guidance in EHR Downtime Procedures Annex (ORRMC-DT-ANX-2026)
Conduct staff briefing on water use policy changes by 08:30
Initiate daily review of water quality test results from Central Plant
fields.photosNote: 2 photos attached: IMG_IPR0740-01 (sign on tap), IMG_IPR0740-02 (capped fountain)

instructorNote: This inject confirms the hospital’s shift to infection prevention protocol under the advisory. The AOC must validate the guidance; the CNO must ensure unit-level communication. Watch for any delay in confirming with the health department.
